domainData: original synthetic laboratory, not employer material

criteria.LAB-READY: Readiness honestly identifies its store and seed.
criteria.LAB-IDENTITY: Version/readiness endpoints contain no secrets and do not pretend to verify an image.
criteria.LAB-AUTH: Catalog data requires authentication; incorrect credentials issue no token.
criteria.LAB-PRODUCT: Products retain stable IDs, active state, positive integer cent prices and price versions.
criteria.LAB-RBAC: Only catalog editors may change products; shoppers cannot mutate the catalog.
criteria.LAB-PRICE: Price changes increment priceVersion; zero, negative and fractional prices are invalid.
criteria.LAB-DISCOUNT: At subtotal >=10000, discount is floor(subtotal*10/100), once on total; otherwise zero.
criteria.LAB-QUANTITY: Each purchased line has integer quantity between 1 and 10 inclusive.
criteria.LAB-ACTIVE: Inactive products cannot be quoted or purchased.
criteria.LAB-STALE: Changed price versions make quote confirmation fail with PRICE_CHANGED.
criteria.LAB-TOTAL: Client totals cannot override the authoritative quote amount.
criteria.LAB-IDEMPOTENCY: Identical key/body replays the same order; key with changed body conflicts.
